summary.en: Open and closed storage in a low-profile living-room piece.
summary.zh: 用低矮柜体组合开放格与封闭收纳。

description.en:
A low-profile TV console shown with light drawer fronts, a darker frame and open centre storage. The two-tone design provides a clear visual contrast while keeping different media items in separate areas.
Confirm the required width, internal layout, leg details and matching pieces for your room schedule.
description.zh:
低矮电视柜搭配浅色抽屉正面、深色框体及中部开放格，可将不同影音物品分区摆放。
请按空间清单确认宽度、内部布局、柜脚细节及配套家具需求。

en: Drawer storage with open centre compartments.
Confirm cabinet width and matching furniture requirements.
zh: 抽屉收纳结合中部开放格。
柜体宽度及配套家具需求另行确认。

value.en: Light fronts with a darker frame and raised legs
value.zh: 浅色正面、深色框体与抬高柜脚

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
